summary: Melco Resorts & Entertainment Limited filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit presenting unaudited second-quarter 2026 earnings. The filing reports total operating revenues of US$1.25 billion, down 6% year-over-year, operating income of US$127.8 million, Adjusted Property EBITDA of US$303.8 million, and net income attributable to the company of US$22.7 million, or US$0.06 per ADS. Management commentary focuses on operational performance, new hotel openings, and regional trends. No special-situation transaction or corporate event is announced; this is a routine periodic earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
